name: Movement-left network
definition: Reviewed DSA membership or endorsement, Justice Democrats endorsement, or both WFP and Our Revolution endorsements in the same cycle.

name: CPC-aligned progressive coalition
definition: Official CPC member or member-elect, or CPC PAC endorsement.

name: National party network
definition: DCCC or DSCC program support, documented national-party intervention, contested-primary leadership endorsement, or elected Democratic leadership.

name: New Dem growth and innovation coalition
definition: Official New Democrat Coalition membership or NewDem Action Fund endorsement.

name: Blue Dog pragmatic and fiscal coalition
definition: Official Blue Dog membership or Blue Dog PAC endorsement.
